title: Keep the missing-contact ceiling visible after improving later chemistry
statement: If first necessary old-new fibre contact has time Exp(g), growth opportunity ends at an independent Exp(d), g,d>0, and no new contact can form afterwards, the chance of useful repair is at most g/(g+d), even with perfect later welding. For M independent such regions all-repair probability is at most[g/(g+d)]^M.

requires: Independent exponential first-contact and growth-shutdown clocks, g,d>0, contact required for the proposed weld and no later contact creation under this model.
Cross-region reliability additionally requires independent regions and the same stated parameters.
provides: If first necessary old-new fibre contact has time Exp(g), growth opportunity ends at an independent Exp(d), g,d>0, and no new contact can form afterwards, the chance of useful repair is at most g/(g+d), even with perfect later welding. For M independent such regions all-repair probability is at most[g/(g+d)]^M.
assumptions: A retained catalytic reserve cannot replace missing physical overlap; an independently supplied growth pathway or pre-existing anchor is a different model.
No measured g/d, actual wet contact law or repeated regeneration is acquired.
costs: Pay the actual contact/growth opportunity and all conditional maturation costs. Improving later chemical yield does not avoid the contact gate.
contract.units: g,d are inverse time; M counts independent regions; all probabilities are dimensionless.
contract.obstruction: Acquire physical old-new contact with its actual lifetime before assigning downstream catalytic gains to structural repair.

body: Integrate g*exp(-(g+d)*t) over t>=0 to obtain contact-first probability. Conditional on contact, memorylessness leaves the shutdown clock exponential, so the separately specified catalytic-maturation success can multiply that contact probability. It never exceeds1 and cannot remove the ceiling. The cross-region product needs independent regions, not merely independent clocks within one region. This is a growth/contact opportunity model, not proof that every enzymatic or physical repair has the same gate. Continued post-shutdown growth or pre-existing contact changes the interface.

evidence.range_scope: Independent contact-before-shutdown ceiling; chemistry cannot rescue absent contact.

review.scope: Completed source-exposed author reconstruction of old/new inclusion-exclusion and the balanced fixed-budget maximum; Poisson thinning conditional on a common clock and Jensen comparison; four-arm small-time quadratic expansion and Laplace N^-1/2 tail; guaranteed positive catalytic-time bound; and the independent exponential contact-race ceiling. The declared capped weaker-end Poisson count is a conditional tail-sum identity, not an accepted constitutive law. Full scientific response and original code were statically read; no code import, quadrature, optimization or Monte Carlo was executed. Primary biochemical/mechanical claims and actual device or regenerative operation are not newly validated.
